grammar.status: An invented finite controlled reading grammar for this exposed paragraph, not a deciphered historical grammar or a cipher writer.
grammar.paragraph_scope: Distinct lexical constants keep one identity for the entire paragraph. The typed Cargo inventory is obtained from all explicit Cargo names in this whole paragraph, including later names; this prospective whole-record scope is an assumption. This inventory is not picked from a safe-path solution. Introduction order used by FIRST is only first occurrences already read, deduplicated by literal whole name. Statements may explain constraints after actions, but no action uses a later name to resolve FIRST.
construction_inventory: Initial := INIT CARGOS COLOC Agent HOME. This declares the Cargo set and Agent at L, establishing their union as the GoalSubject.
Goal := GOAL BankName WITHOUT_HARM HARM. It registers the BankName R as GoalBank and requests that GoalSubject arrive unharmed. It does not move anyone.
SafetyRule := UNSAFE PAIRS FORBIDDEN WHEN WITHOUT_AGENT Agent. Pair co-location is forbidden exactly when that Agent is at the other bank.
Capacity := AT_MOST_ONE BESIDES Agent EXAMPLE Cargo. This declares capacity for the unique Vehicle named in the paragraph and introduces the example Cargo without moving it.

Trip := WITH_TRIP Entity TripCore | TripCore. WITH_TRIP binds Vehicle as instrument or Cargo as load according to the fixed lexical type; it cannot create either. A conflicting duplicate argument makes the construction undefined.

TripCore := TAKE_OUT CargoRef | CONVEY_OUT NEXT CargoRef | FERRY CargoRef | RETURN_EXCLUDING CargoRef | RETURN ALONE | RETURN with an inherited WITH_TRIP Cargo | FINALLY OUTWARD TRAVEL_TOGETHER Agent CargoRef.

OUT operations go to R, RETURN operations to L, FERRY to the bank opposite the current bank. Every complete TripCore denotes exactly one prescribed voyage by the same Agent M and Vehicle B. Non-local cargo cannot be loaded. Cargo capacity is at most one. No silent boat or cargo movements are supplied.

RETURN_EXCLUDING X allows only locally available zero-or-one loads not containing X. It does not silently mean empty in every possible context, and does not choose using safety. If more than one load survives local availability/exclusion/capacity, the reading remains ambiguous. In S07 only G is local, so the sole allowed load is empty.
THEN is a discourse sequencer applicable to a Trip or Assertion. It is not the W91 proof operator; the type of the following head determines whether any movement occurs.

PairAssertion := CargoRef PAIRED_WITH UNATTENDED CargoRef WOULD_BE UNSAFE. Its two argument positions are preserved. The absent Agent is the unique M; this is a conditional property of a pair, not a current-world absence assertion.

FrameCopy := LIKEWISE OTHER_CARGO. It copies the most recent complete PairAssertion in textual order, replacing argument1 only and retaining argument2, absence condition, modal force and predicate. It cannot copy a trip or an incomplete fragment.

FIRST_CARGO selects the first distinct previously written Cargo name. OTHER_CARGO selects the unique member of the previously named Cargo inventory after removing both arguments of the copied PairAssertion. Zero or multiple eligible members makes OTHER undefined; no choice by safety or wished-for continuation.

Stay := LEAVE THERE. Subject is the Cargo of the immediately preceding actual Trip, never the nearest untyped noun. It requires that exact Cargo to remain at GoalBank through the next Trip unless explicitly carried. If that previous trip had no cargo, this construction is undefined.

Result := JOINING_RESULT REST_CARGO COLOC CargoRef. Subject is the Agent+Cargo travellers of the immediately preceding actual Trip. REST_CARGO is the already named Cargo set minus that previous load. It asserts resultant co-location, not a new journey.
Conclusion := THUS ALL UNHARMED THERE ATTENDED_BY Agent. ALL quantifies the paragraph Cargo set. THERE always refers to GoalBank R. This is a whole-result claim, not another instruction.
closed_world_assumptions: Only the four people/cargo identities M,W,G,C and one boat B occur; no new cargo comes into existence.
Unsafe pair assertions in this whole unit exhaust the prohibited-pair relation within this model. This is a closed-list hypothesis, not an independently observed manuscript convention.
Boat and Agent move together on each voyage. A trip macro includes loading/crossing/depositing the named cargo at the destination bank; no hidden interbank motion is allowed.
The one Agent/Vehicle context is retained across intervening declarations and explanations; no per-line reset.
No line boundary is asserted to be a historical sentence boundary. The displayed segmentation is an exploratory choice, not a search-proven unique parse.
Semantically synonymous TAKE_OUT and CONVEY_OUT remain two freely hypothesized whole lexical forms; no source fact or productive morphology explains their contrast.
explicit_type_and_position_changes: solkeedy/WITH_TRIP precedes a Vehicle in S05 but a Cargo in S09; its two typed binding cases are explicitly stipulated. It never becomes a ferry verb.
sar/UNSAFE modifies PAIRS in S03 and predicates the conditional pair in S11; both refer to the same unsafe-pair relation.
otor/COLOC occurs in Initial and Result frames; it is static co-location in both and never a trip.
sol/THEN precedes an actual trip in S06 and an explanatory assertion in S10. It merely orders discourse, so no implicit voyage or proof is licensed.
otedy/RETURN has Cargo G supplied by WITH_TRIP in S09 and an explicitly empty load supplied by ALONE in S15; its direction and active Agent/Vehicle do not change.
otaiin/THERE is GoalBank R in both S14 and S18; no current-bank or speaker-position switch.
ched/WITHOUT_AGENT and shdy/WITHOUT_HARM are separate whole-word hypotheses in different argument domains; no shared Voynich morpheme is claimed.

manual_conditional_trace.status: Hand-written illustration of the already owned RAW349 path under the new speculative alignment; no fresh source theorem, computer replay, solver or test result.
manual_conditional_trace.boat_policy: B remains with M; availability of B at first departure is presupposed by the written WITH_TRIP B.
manual_conditional_trace.event_owners: Exactly S05/S07/S08/S09/S13/S15/S16 carry the seven actual prescribed interbank changes. Declarations, named examples, pair conditions, copied assertion, Stay, Result and Conclusion are not voyages.

conditional_consequences: S07 is empty because its explicit excluded cargo G is the only cargo at the departure bank after S05. A bare noun count cannot derive that fact.
FIRST at S08 resolves W from textual introduction order, independently of the intended safe history; it is not chosen as the cargo that makes the puzzle solvable.
The W/G rule in S12 is a copied C/G frame with one text-determined substitution. It does not require another W token, an invisible wolf voyage or a fresh lexical value for the written W.
After S08, returning alone would leave W/G unattended, while the explicit G load of S09 prevents it. The rule may be explained later in prose; no earlier invalid inference is imported as a premise.
After S13, C is explicitly left at R; ALONE in S15 prevents C from silently returning. The later C mention in S17 is co-location, not an eighth voyage.

The final ALL/THERE/ATTENDED_BY claim is tied to the original identities and R and would be false if the transport sequence or safety declarations were changed inconsistently. These consequences are conditional on the newly chosen lexicon and grammar.

complete_rivals.name: MOST_RECENT_REFERENCE
complete_rivals.whole_reading: Keep every clause and all six inherited values. Read the single reference word saiin as most-recently named Cargo instead of FIRST_CARGO, everywhere that word occurs. All other clauses remain literally the 18 listed clauses.
complete_rivals.changed_clause: S08 now orders Ferry G; S01–S07 and S09–S18 are unchanged.
complete_rivals.consequence: After S07 the attendant is at L but G remains R, so S08 has no locally available G to load. This is a concrete inconsistent complete counterreading under otherwise identical rules, not a new manuscript test or proof that saiin means first.

complete_rivals.name: OPPOSITE_RETURN_ARGUMENT
complete_rivals.whole_reading: Keep all clauses, references and six inherited values. Change the singleton cheeety uniformly from RETURN_EXCLUDING to RETURN_WITH, taking its same explicit argument.
complete_rivals.changed_clause: S07 becomes Return with G to L; all other clauses unchanged.
complete_rivals.consequence: S08 then takes W outward while G and C remain at L without M, contrary to the unchanged C/G safety assertion. At S09 G is not with M at R either. The final safe-history assertion cannot hold. No invisible relocation is allowed to rescue it.

complete_rivals.name: INSTRUCTION_VERSUS_REPORTED_PLAN
complete_rivals.whole_reading: The entire 18-clause account can be read as instructions for a prospective safe plan or as a narrated description of the same prescribed seven steps. All entity, condition and voyage bindings remain identical.
complete_rivals.consequence: The content model does not identify tense, speaker, report-versus-imperative mood or actual historical performance. This surviving whole-discourse alternative is not selected by the conditional state relations.

limits_and_conflicts: The sol/chedy division between S10 and S11 lies at an uncertain ZL small space, per parent collation. This draft requires that division but does not certify it. IT/RF variants are retained as unresolved alternatives, not silently assimilated.

Forty-one new whole-word meanings are proposed after seeing the paragraph and known solution. Thirty-six of these are singletons. Their fit is not independent evidence; no rarity or statistical success is claimed.
No arbitrary per-occurrence meaning switch occurs, but one fixed value per singleton is still a major freedom. A zero-UNKNOWN constructed assignment is not a complete discovered translation.

FIRST_CARGO, OTHER_CARGO and frame-copy semantics are precise inventions, not independently measured properties of saiin, otchedy or schedair. The chosen participant types themselves are hypothetical.
Initial CARGOS and early capacity use paragraph-wide type declarations. This forward scope and closed-list safety interpretation have no separate historical or manuscript justification.
TAKE_OUT and CONVEY_OUT have identical transport truth conditions. Their different spellings remain unexplained lexical synonymy, not evidence for a reusable subword alternation.
The surface code of directed components, productive whole forms and entry/position effects is still unwritten. This finite whole-form reading table does not explain that structural baseline.
